description: Source code for AuthActivity, which manages user authentication flows including login and signup in an Android app. It handles UI interactions and communicates with backend via a repository provided by a ServiceLocator.

classes.name: AuthActivity
classes.description: An Android activity that manages user authentication, providing UI for login and signup, and interacting with a backend repository for authentication operations.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Overrides AppCompatActivity's onCreate method to set up the authentication UI, initialize views, and handle user interactions for login/signup.

methods.name: updateMode
methods.description: Nested function that updates UI elements based on whether the user is signing up or logging in.
